segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the last four digits on the billing contact phone?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Nolan at Crestview Analytics. Last four are 2481. I’m trying to confirm our seat reduction for next month’s invoice.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I see Crestview Analytics, account ending in 773. You’re currently at 42 seats on the Business plan, billed monthly at $1,890. Are you looking to reduce to 35 seats for the September 1 billing cycle?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Exactly. We removed seven inactive users yesterday, but the admin console still shows the old total in the subscription area.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, so the user list updated, but the subscription quantity needs to be synced from our side. I can set the quantity to 35 effective September 1. Your September invoice should drop to $1,575 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what finance expected. Will there be any credit for August?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No credit for August since the change is scheduled for the next cycle, not mid-cycle. I’m adding that to ticket 48126 so there’s a record.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Can you send the confirmation to billing@crestviewanalytics.com too?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes. After we disconnect, I’ll retype the change summary into the billing tool, copy the ticket details into the admin console notes, and attach the confirmation for that billing alias.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re all set. You should see the subscription total show 35 seats within about an hour.
